title: The Gibeonite Deception

questions.question: Who gathered together to fight Joshua?
options: All the kings beyond the Jordan in the hill country and lowland
questions.correctAnswer: All the kings beyond the Jordan in the hill country and lowland
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:1 (ESV): "...all the kings who were beyond the Jordan in the hill country and in the lowland... gathered together..."

questions.question: What strategy did the inhabitants of Gibeon use?
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:4 (ESV): "they on their part acted with cunning..."

questions.question: How did the Gibeonites dress?
options: Worn-out sacks, old wineskins, patched sandals, and dry bread
questions.correctAnswer: Worn-out sacks, old wineskins, patched sandals, and dry bread
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:4-5 (ESV): "...put worn-out sacks on their donkeys, and wineskins, old and torn and mended... worn-out and patched sandals..."

questions.question: Where did the Gibeonites say they came from?
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:9 (ESV): "From a very distant country your servants have come..."

questions.question: What mistake did the men of Israel make?
options: They did not ask counsel from the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: They did not ask counsel from the Lord
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:14 (ESV): "So the men took some of their provisions, but did not ask counsel from the Lord."

questions.question: When did Israel discover the deception?
options: Three days after they had made a covenant
questions.correctAnswer: Three days after they had made a covenant
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:16 (ESV): "At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors..."

questions.question: Why did the leaders not attack the Gibeonites after discovering the truth?
options: Because of the oath they had sworn by the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the oath they had sworn by the Lord
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:19 (ESV): "...We have sworn to them by the Lord, the God of Israel, and now we may not touch them."

questions.question: What role were the Gibeonites given?
options: Cutters of wood and drawers of water
questions.correctAnswer: Cutters of wood and drawers of water
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:21 (ESV): "...let them be cutters of wood and drawers of water for all the congregation."

questions.question: Which cities belonged to the Gibeonites?
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:17 (ESV): "...now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim."

questions.question: What reason did the Gibeonites give for their deception when confronted?
options: They feared for their lives because God commanded Moses to destroy all inhabitants
questions.correctAnswer: They feared for their lives because God commanded Moses to destroy all inhabitants
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:24 (ESV): "...it was told to your servants for a certainty that the Lord your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land and to destroy all the inhabitants..."

questions.question: The Gibeonites became "hewers of wood and drawers of water" for whom specifically?
options: For the congregation and for the altar of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: For the congregation and for the altar of the Lord
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:27 (ESV): "...cutters of wood and drawers of water for the congregation and for the altar of the Lord..."

questions.question: Why specifically did the Gibeonites claim their bread was dry?
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:12 (ESV): "Here is our bread. It was still warm when we took it... now behold, it is dry and crumbly."

questions.question: What was the reaction of the congregation of Israel to the leaders' oath?
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:18 (ESV): "...But all the congregation murmured against the leaders."

questions.question: What ethnicity were the Gibeonites identified as in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:7 (ESV): "But the men of Israel said to the Hivites..."

questions.question: Where was the camp of Israel located during this event?
questions.explanation: Joshua 9:6 (ESV): "And they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal..."

key_verse_text: So the men took some of their provisions, but did not ask counsel from the LORD. (ESV)
